021import net.tnemc.core.TNECore;

029import net.tnemc.core.transaction.TransactionParticipant;

035
036import java.util.Collections;
037import java.util.Date;
038import java.util.Optional;
039import java.util.UUID;
040
041/**
042 * TransactionInfoPage
043 *
044 * @author creatorfromhell
045 * @since 0.1.2.0
046 */
047public class TransactionInfoPage {
048
049  private final String returnMenu;
050  private final int returnPage;
051  private final String transactionID;
052
053  public TransactionInfoPage(final String returnMenu, final int returnPage, final String transactionID) {
054
055    this.returnMenu = returnMenu;
056    this.returnPage = returnPage;
057    this.transactionID = transactionID;
058  }
059
060  public void handle(final PageOpenCallback callback) {
061
062    final Optional<MenuViewer> viewer = callback.getPlayer().viewer();
063    if(viewer.isPresent()) {
064
065      callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("BARRIER", 1)
066                                                         .customName(Component.text("Escape Menu"))
067                                                         .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("Click to exit this menu."))))
068                                         .withActions(new PageSwitchWithClose(returnMenu, returnPage))
069                                         .withSlot(0)
070                                         .build());
071
072      final Optional<Object> transactionObj = viewer.get().findData(transactionID);
073      if(transactionObj.isEmpty()) {
074        return;
075      }
076
077      try {
078
079        final UUID id = UUID.fromString((String)transactionObj.get());
080        final Optional<Receipt> receipt = TransactionManager.receipts().getReceiptByUUID(id);
081        if(receipt.isPresent()) {
082
083          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("CLOCK", 1)
084                                                             .customName(Component.text(TNECore.eco().transaction().getFormat().format(new Date(receipt.get().getTime()))))
085                                                             .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("Time of Transaction"))))
086                                             .withSlot(2)
087                                             .build());
088
089          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("NAME_TAG", 1)
090                                                             .customName(Component.text(id.toString()))
091                                                             .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("UUID of Transaction"))))
092                                             .withSlot(4)
093                                             .build());
094
095          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("PAPER", 1)
096                                                             .customName(Component.text(receipt.get().getType()))
097                                                             .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("Type of Transaction"))))
098                                             .withSlot(6)
099                                             .build());
100
101          final String source = (receipt.get().getSource() != null)? receipt.get().getSource().asString() : "No Source Logged";
102          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("PAPER", 1)
103                                                             .customName(Component.text(source))
104                                                             .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("Source of Transaction"))))
105                                             .withSlot(8)
106                                             .build());
107
108          addParticipant(callback, receipt.get().getTo(), receipt.get().getModifierTo(), "To Account",
109                         24, 27, 28, 29, 30);
110          addParticipant(callback, receipt.get().getFrom(), receipt.get().getModifierFrom(), "From Account",
111                         19, 32, 33, 34, 35);
112
113          //barrier icons
114          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("WHITE_GLASS_PANE", 1)
115                                                             .customName(Component.text("")))
116                                             .withSlot(18).build());
117
118          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("WHITE_GLASS_PANE", 1)
119                                                             .customName(Component.text("")))
120                                             .withSlot(20).build());
121
122          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("WHITE_GLASS_PANE", 1)
123                                                             .customName(Component.text("")))
124                                             .withSlot(21).build());
125
126          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("WHITE_GLASS_PANE", 1)
127                                                             .customName(Component.text("")))
128                                             .withSlot(22).build());
129
130          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("WHITE_GLASS_PANE", 1)
131                                                             .customName(Component.text("")))
132                                             .withSlot(31).build());
133
134          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("WHITE_GLASS_PANE", 1)
135                                                             .customName(Component.text("")))
136                                             .withSlot(23).build());
137
138          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("WHITE_GLASS_PANE", 1)
139                                                             .customName(Component.text("")))
140                                             .withSlot(25).build());
141
142          callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("WHITE_GLASS_PANE", 1)
143                                                             .customName(Component.text("")))
144                                             .withSlot(26).build());
145        }
146
147      } catch(final Exception ignore) {
148      }
149    }
150  }
151
152  private void addParticipant(final PageOpenCallback callback, final TransactionParticipant participant,
153                              final HoldingsModifier modifier, final String accountLabel,
154                              final int accountSlot, final int currencySlot, final int regionSlot,
155                              final int amountSlot, final int operationSlot) {
156
157    if(participant == null || modifier == null) {
158      return;
159    }
160    final Optional<Account> account = participant.asAccount();
161    final String name = account.isPresent()? account.get().getName() : "No Name";
162    callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("PLAYER_HEAD", 1)
163                                                       .profile(skullProfile(account))
164                                                       .customName(Component.text(name))
165                                                       .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text(accountLabel))))
166                                       .withSlot(accountSlot).build());
167
168    final Currency currency = TNECore.eco().currency().findOrDefault(modifier.getCurrency());
169    callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of(currency.getIconMaterial(), 1)
170                                                       .customName(Component.text(currency.getIdentifier()))
171                                                       .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("Modifier Currency"))))
172                                       .withSlot(currencySlot).build());
173    callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("MAP", 1)
174                                                       .customName(Component.text(modifier.getRegion()))
175                                                       .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("Modifier Region"))))
176                                       .withSlot(regionSlot).build());
177    callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("GOLD_INGOT", 1)
178                                                       .customName(Component.text(modifier.getModifier().toPlainString()))
179                                                       .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("Modifier Amount"))))
180                                       .withSlot(amountSlot).build());
181    callback.getPage().addIcon(new IconBuilder(PluginCore.server().stackBuilder().of("REDSTONE_TORCH", 1)
182                                                       .customName(Component.text(modifier.getOperation().name()))
183                                                       .lore(Collections.singletonList(Component.text("Modifier Operation"))))
184                                       .withSlot(operationSlot).build());
185  }
186
187  private SkullProfile skullProfile(final Optional<Account> account) {
188
189    try {
190      if(account.isPresent() && account.get() instanceof final PlayerAccount playerAccount) {
191        final SkullProfile profile = new SkullProfile();
192        if(PluginCore.server().playedBefore(playerAccount.getUUID())) {
193          profile.uuid(playerAccount.getUUID());
194        }
195        return profile;
196      }
197    } catch(final Exception ignore) { }
198    return null;
199  }
200}
